notes_for_editor: Thin record. Three sources: the NGS datasheet FB2450 is the only detailed description (1963, USGS); the Forest Lookouts North Carolina list gives the agency only; tnlandforms gives the survey code and coordinates. No build date, tower height, staffing or later history was found. A Natural Atlas page for Sutton Top Lookout exists, and a search snippet describes it as in Pisgah National Forest, but its page text was not readable with fetch_text, so it is not cited. Record coordinates (35.73333, -83.05138) match the datasheet position to about 0.0005 degree; no correction. The datasheet's 41 FT figure is ambiguous (height or base), and the story says so rather than choosing. Two web searches and the local cache turned up nothing more. A Pisgah or Forest Service district page is the next place to look for build date and status. Status and access remain unknown; the story makes no claim about the summit today.
